references.text: Abraham's servant asks God for guidance and success on his journey, similar to the prayer to know if the journey will succeed
The priest was to ask God through the Urim to receive guidance regarding Israel's ways and decisions
The children of Israel asked the Lord who should go up first against the Canaanites, a request similar to seeking God's will
The children of Israel asked God if they should go up to battle, the same type of request for God's guidance
In Israel, people went to the seer to ask God, illustrating the practice of seeking divine guidance
David asked the Lord whether he should go and strike down the Philistines, a similar prayer for guidance regarding a journey or action
Jehoshaphat asked to first inquire of the Lord, showing the practice of seeking God's will before important decisions
The people asked the prophet to pray for them and ask the Lord about the way they should go
